thread:
rachel (AE): quick sync 11 Customer: FinServX wants a 2-week pilot. Goals: 1) invoice extraction into structured JSON, 2) short policy answers for support, 3) demonstrable cost saving vs current pipeline. Need prompt samples, acceptance metrics, and minimum security posture.

diego (SE): i'll assemble a 20-row prompt inventory covering broken OCR, missing totals, multi-currency, and nested line items. question: will inputs be raw PDFs or OCR->text?

rachel (AE): OCR->text pipeline provided by customer. include a few prompts that preserve original spans plus normalized values.

sam (ML Eng): baseline extractor prompt (strict JSON):
```
System: Output only JSON with keys: vendor, invoice_date(ISO), currency, total, items[]. Include confidence 0-1 for each.
User: <OCR_TEXT>
```
policy QA prompt (closed-source retrieval):
```
System: Use only the provided docs. If no relevant info, reply "No relevant info found." Keep answer concise.
User: <question>
```
These are good for automated evals.

kyle (Pricing): POC credits: we can cover 60k tokens/day for 14 days. if spike concurrency >10 we should discuss temporary reserved capacity. need SE token estimate per request.

diego (SE): estimate ~450 tokens per extraction request (input+output) and ~150 tokens per policy QA. peak concurrency ~8-12. batching for background jobs expected.

meera (Security): minimal POC controls: TLS, RBAC for team, redact PII in logs, optional CMK for keys. real-data uploads require a DPA addendum; recommend synthetic week1, gated real uploads week2 after sign-off. i'll draft answers for their questionnaire today.

olivia (CSM): proposed acceptance thresholds: vendor/total exact_match >= 91%, hallucination_rate < 3% for policy QA, p50 latency < 450ms for extraction, cost <= $0.03/request. if fallback used, mark used_fallback = true in metadata.

rachel (AE): owners & timeline: diego -> prompt CSV + sample outputs (48h), sam -> eval harness + thresholds (72h), meera -> security one-pager + questionnaire answers (EOD), kyle -> credits note (24h), olivia+rachel -> kickoff and demo plan (this week).

diego (SE): ack. i'll also include a small notebook and a regex fallback for totals/tax with used_fallback flag. uploading to shared drive.
